name: C11_TWO_OCTAHEDRON_CHANNEL_STRUCTURE_GATE_V1
motivation: Replace mechanical separator-ladder continuation by a direct audit of the inter-core channel geometry that generated the verified kappa=1,2,3,>=4 witnesses.

frozen_frame.fixed_non_cross_structure: All old-seed, stored-111, post-constructor, intra-octahedron, hub, and non-cross-block edges are exactly those of the sealed Q2 witness.
frozen_frame.only_variable_edges: Edges between the left and right octahedron blocks whose endpoints lie in the frozen effective port sets below.
admissibility_requires: The frozen provenance coloring remains proper after all selected variable cross edges are added.
All old/post seeded-precoloring axioms and stored-111/Q authority remain valid.
The full 20-vertex upstream graph is exhaustively P7-free.
The frozen route-34 propagation reproduces the exact intended residual/list semantics.
No extension oracle is used to select cross edges.
frozen_frame.scientific_scope_note: Universal statements from this gate apply only to this explicitly finite frozen two-octahedron port-channel frame. They are not automatically universal statements about all C11 residuals.

derivation.left: These are exactly the left-octahedron neighbors of anchor c0 outside its own part.
derivation.right: These are exactly the right-octahedron neighbors of anchor f0 outside its own part.

channel_object.port_channel_graph: X(C) is the bipartite graph on left_port_set union right_port_set whose edges are the selected actual cross-block edges.
channel_object.direct_channel_from_edge: Every edge u-v in X gives the c0-f0 path c0-u-v-f0.
channel_object.independent_direct_channels: A set of direct channels is internally vertex-disjoint exactly when the corresponding X-edges form a matching.
channel_object.direct_channel_number: nu(X), the maximum matching size of X.
channel_object.total_bundle_number: 1 + nu(X), counting the frozen hub path c0-z-f0.

current_positive_control.role: Mandatory classifier/provenance control; not evidence of a universal bound.

finite_search_space.exhaustive_universality_rule: Because the frozen frame domain is explicitly finite, a universal statement over THIS FRAME may be certified by complete enumeration of every raw port graph together with a proof-carrying completeness count and independent replay. Sampling or incomplete corpus success is insufficient.

matching_shape_axis.hypothesis: Every authoritative admissible frame descendant has Delta(X)<=1, i.e. the effective port-channel graph is a matching.

M1_PORT_CHANNEL_MATCHING_STRUCTURE_UNIVE.requirement: Theorem/proof-carrying authority or complete finite-frame enumeration proves Delta(X)<=1 for every admissible descendant.
M1_PORT_CHANNEL_MATCHING_STRUCTURE_UNIVE.ceiling: Only the frozen frame is covered.

requirement: Explicit port vertex incident with at least two cross-channel edges, so Delta(X)>=2.
Full upstream C11/P7-free/route replay and independent verification.
M2_NONMATCHING_PORT_CHANNEL_WITNESS.meaning: Matching shape is not forced even in the frozen frame.

independent_channel_count_axis.hypothesis: Every authoritative admissible frame descendant has nu(X)<=3.

C1_DIRECT_CHANNEL_MATCHING_NUMBER_LE3_UN.requirement: Theorem/proof-carrying authority or complete finite-frame enumeration proves nu(X)<=3 for every admissible descendant.
C1_DIRECT_CHANNEL_MATCHING_NUMBER_LE3_UN.meaning: Within this frozen frame, a fourth independent direct channel is impossible.

requirement: Explicit matching of four actual X-edges with eight distinct port endpoints.
Hence four internally vertex-disjoint direct c0-f0 paths plus the frozen hub path.
Full upstream C11/P7-free/route replay and independent verification.
C2_FOURTH_INDEPENDENT_DIRECT_CHANNEL_WIT.meaning: Within this frozen frame, a fourth independent direct channel is possible.
ceiling: Does not imply unbounded channel number.
Does not imply kappa(C)>=5 globally unless separately certified by the appropriate cut audit.
Does not open separator size 4 or 5.

mandatory_classifier_controls.name: SYNTHETIC_PERFECT_MATCHING4_CONTROL
mandatory_classifier_controls.note: Do NOT infer P7-freeness or C11 admissibility from this classifier control.

for_every_authoritative_witness: exact maximum matching certificate and independently recomputed nu(X)
explicit internally-disjoint path family corresponding to the reported matching
for_universal_finite_frame_result: every raw port graph accounted exactly once
universal property checked on every admissible frame descendant

anti_cheat: Do not inspect separator size 4 as a new universal frontier.
Do not infer channel universality outside the frozen frame.
Do not use an extension oracle to choose cross edges.
Do not treat the synthetic perfect-matching control as an authoritative fourth-channel witness.
Do not infer global vertex connectivity from local channel matching number without a separate cut certificate.
Do not open backdoor size 2, tw4, repair, or a new C11 state descriptor.
Do not alter C11 or PI semantics.
next_action: Separate authorization required. Audit the frozen two-octahedron port-channel frame on both axes; do not continue the separator ladder automatically.
